ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Feud with Jerome Powell
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's feud with Jerome Powell, including the potential motivations behind the administration's actions and the impact on the Federal Reserve and the economy.
ideas.angle: Investigative analysis of the Trump administration's actions and potential wrongdoing
questions: What are the motivations behind the Trump administration's feud with Jerome Powell?
How will this feud impact the Federal Reserve and the economy?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing by the Trump administration and its impact on the economy. By following the money and analyzing the administration's actions, we can gain a deeper understanding of the motivations behind this feud and its potential consequences.
